prompt: Our web shop redirects customers to a hosted payment page. Which SAQ applies and what are the eligibility conditions?
assertions: Identifies SAQ A for card-not-present merchants with all cardholder data functions fully outsourced to PCI-compliant third parties (redirect or compliant iframe)
States the merchant's site must not receive/transmit/store cardholder data — only pointing to the payment processor
Notes SAQ A now includes requirements addressing e-commerce skimming risk (script management 6.4.3 and change/tamper detection 11.6.1 style controls)
Distinguishes SAQ A-EP: merchants whose site affects the security of the payment redirect (e.g., JavaScript-created payment form) face the much larger SAQ A-EP
Advises confirming SAQ eligibility with the acquirer, which determines validation requirements
